messages:
samir: DeployBot popped a canary failure in eu-west2 after tonight's rollout — p50 jumped ~3x and a few 502s. tagging @oncall_kevin @hannah for quick decision: regional pin or full rollback?

hannah: on it, pulling traces. Do we know if artifact changed or infra?

oncall_kevin: we need to choose within 10m. Pin region is fastest and keeps traffic stable. Rollback would be global and cause churn.

deploybot: Canary summary -> failures=6, p50-ms=410 (baseline ~130ms), error-rate=0.9%. Suggested actions: `pin` or `rollback`. Use `/deploy expedite <action>` to proceed.

samir: artifacts identical across regions; traces point to increased syscall latency on subset of hosts deployed this morning. leaning pin to previous image `redwood/serve:2026.03.07-stable`.

hannah: QA confirmed no model diffs. +1 for pin. If pin fixes it, we update release notes and file infra ticket.

oncall_kevin: executing pin now:
`/deploy pin --region eu-west2 --image redwood/serve:2026.03.07-stable --reason "expedite pin: post-release syscall latency"`

releasebot: Pin request accepted. Rolling pin in eu-west2. Expected duration ~3m. Notifying on-call and release owners.

infra_ella: FYI kernel team deployed image batch img-20260307-3 earlier. Creating INFRA-5012 and attaching traces/host-ids.

deploybot: Pin progress: 11/11 hosts pinned. Health checks: passing. Telemetry: p50 returned to baseline within 95s. Error-rate dropped to 0.06%.

docsbot: Release notes are live for the current version. I'll prepare a short amendment: "Temporarily reverted infra image in eu-west2 due to latency spike; investigating." Shall I open PR now?

hannah: yes please, link PR here so we can merge quickly.

docsbot: PR -> https://git.internal/docs/PR-1642. Short blurb added and changelog bumped.

oncall_kevin: INFRA-5012 created. Kernel/image team looped in. Leaving canary sensitivity elevated for 24h.

samir: running a 10m synthetic against pinned pool to validate; posting results in 9m.

hannah: thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. If alerts return, reopen thread. Otherwise mark expedited approval closed. :thumbsup:
